settings.title: Size & Perfect-Fit Guarantee
settings.content:
Not sure which size suits your shape? Tap “Find my true size” under the size picker to take our 15-second Fit Quiz. Or just check the full size guide beside it, just measure your waist in cm/inch and match it to your size.

Perfect-Fit Guarantee
Order your best-guess size with confidence. If the fit isn’t quite right, you can make a free exchange through our returnportal.

settings.title: Shipping & Exchanges
settings.content:
Orders are delivered in 3–6 business days (excluding pre-orders) with track & trace. Free shipping applies above €100.

Exchanges
Exchanges are always free. If the fit isn’t quite right, you can swap sizes at no cost through our return portal.

Returns
Refunds are available within 14 days. Return labels are purchased directly in the portal before you confirm. Items must be in original condition. See full Returns Policy.

settings.title: FAQ
settings.content:
How do I measure my waist?
Use a measuring tape around the smallest part of your waist, usually near your belly button.

How do I know CURVJEANS will fit?
Check our size guide with real measurements and try our Fit Quiz. Still unsure? Exchanges are completely free.

How long are the jeans?
Length depends on your legs! Inseam options are listed in our size guide.

I wear this size in other brands, can I choose the same for CURVJEANS?
Sizing varies by brand, so we always recommend measuring your waist and checking our size guide.

Will my jeans stretch out after wearing them?
No, our premium stretch fabric keeps its shape.
